I can't answer this from the files I have, so I don't have per-year case counts or a year with the most cases.

My working directory (`/tmp/r2run-x1djwahn`) holds no order documents. It contains only dotfiles, editor and tool config (`.idea`, `.vscode`, `.mcp.json`, `.claude/`), and a few entries that are character devices. Nothing in it is a IURC order, a recommendation form, or any dig-damage data, and it isn't a git repository with a history I can mine. The data this analysis needs would be the 58 orders dated 2021-01-01 through 2025-12-31, and those aren't here.

I haven't searched outside the working directory. Your instructions limit me to it, and the sandbox also denies other project paths such as `/home/claude/projects/dig-risk-control`.

To answer, I need the order files placed in the working directory, or the path to the folder that holds them. Once I have them, I'll count cases per order year (2021 through 2025) by the order's date, and report which year has the most. I won't give an estimate here, since any number would be a guess with no basis in the data.
